title: Good
text:
Good. These are just as described. My minus 2 stars comes from the fact you can only buy 2 at a time.
This allows the maker to see you bought some, know you'll need more, then price gouge the customer. They did this to me. I am upset.
I ultimately paid 4x the amount for the last 2 i needed, but am disappointed in the scam-like way that this ordeal has been enacted.
Please cut this out and allow for people to order more than 2 curtain panels at a time! I would have otherwise given 5 stars, had the bait&switch not occurred.
Thank you.

product_metadata.title: Eclipse Solid Thermapanel Modern Room Darkening Thermal Rod Pocket Window Curtain for Bedroom, 54 in x 54 in, River Blue
features: PREMIUM QUALITY - Masterfully crafted 100% Polyester room darkening curtains. Sold as a single panel

LIGHT BLOCKING LEVEL - Eclipse Room-Darkening curtains are designed to block harsh sunlight rays, while still providing beautiful ambient lighting in a room. Perfect for your living room, bedroom, kids room, nursery and more!

ENERGY EFFICIENT - Patented Thermaback technology designed to block out intrusive sunlight reduces unwanted noise and offers thermal benefits while providing all of the luxury and style of naturally flowing draperies. Provides an insulated barrier against summer heat and winter chill to balance your room temperature and save on energy bills.
EASY SET UP - 2 inch rod pocket accommodates up to a 1.25 inch curtain rod. Ready to be hung right away.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - Machine washable in gentle cycle and cold water, do not bleach. Warm iron and tumble dry at low temperatures.
description: Redecorate in a snap with Eclipse solid Thermapanel room-darkening curtains. These beautiful panels offer a superior blend of window fashion design and light blocking technology for any decor. Solid, drapeable curtain is woven with energy saving yarns so that the technology blends seamlessly with fashion fabrics. Each rod pocket Thermapanel curtain measures 54 inches wide by your choice of 63 or 84 inches long. 2 inch rod pocket accommodates up to a 1.25 inch curtain rod. Available in black, merlot, mushroom, Navy, River Blue, and stone. Curtain rod sold separately. Sold as a single panel. 100percent polyester. Machine wash gentle cycle, tumble dry, do not bleach. Imported.
